system.description:
Growing Unique (spear +1).

Dormant (when found, save DC 13): it returns to your hand when thrown.

Awakened (bearer 9th level, save DC 15): the spear is +2; once per day, a thrown hit makes the ground erupt: 3d6 force to each creature within 10ft (Reflex half).

Exalted (bearer 17th level, save DC 17): the spear is +3; the eruption deals 6d6.

Monsters & Treasure, Growing Uniques. Each state adds to the one before. It falls back to Dormant with a new bearer. Its bonus is +1 Dormant, +2 Awakened and +3 Exalted: raise it on the item when it wakes.
